stories.title: France beat Argentina to set up Nations Championship final with South Africa
summary: They confirmed top spot in the northern hemisphere table with the required bonus-point win, finishing on 26 points with five wins out of six.
England (five bonus points) and Ireland (four bonus points) also won five matches, but finish second and third respectively.

stories.title: ‘I didn’t know’: former Australia Test coach Darren Lehmann denies any knowledge of sandpaper use
summary: Lehmann’s version of events of 2018 tour remain unchanged‘We’ve just got to try to move on’ from ball tampering sagaDarren Lehmann has denied knowledge of a plan to use sandpaper to alter the ball during Australia’s Test tour of South Africa in 2018, contradicting Cameron Bancroft’s claims.The former Australian Test coach was implicated in Bancroft’s 4,000-plus word statement on the events that led to the Western Australian being busted on-field with sandpaper down his trousers in Cape Town.

stories.title: Rising star Stirling knocks out Prochazka
summary: Rising star Navajo Stirling earns the biggest win of his career as he knocks out former champion Jiri Prochazka in the second round at UFC Qatar.

stories.title: ‘Obviously it’s not good’: Arteta sweating over David Raya’s fitness after injury
summary: The Spaniard was helped off in evident pain and looked close to tears.

stories.title: ‘GO NAVY’ becomes ‘GO ARMY’ after overnight prank at Navy football stadium
summary: Cadets rearranged bolted-down seats overnightNavy workers spent four hours undoing stuntRival academies have long history of pranksThe large letters that spell “GO NAVY” in the upper seating level of the Naval Academy’s football stadium were changed to “GO ARMY” in an elaborate overnight prank before the Midshipmen hosted No 24 Memphis on Saturday.The stunt involved rearranging the blue and yellow seat backs at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium in Annapolis, Maryland, a task made considerably more complicated by the fact that the seats are bolted into place.

stories.title: Alcaraz holds off Shelton to set up final showdown with Zverev at ATP Finals
summary: Ferrero is one of the most highly respected coaches on tour, but he also knows Carlos Alcaraz better than any other coach in the world.However, there is only so much that anyone can do against one of the sport’s greatest talents.

stories.title: Raya set to have scan on injury - how much would Arsenal miss him?
summary: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.

stories.title: WSL roundup: Chelsea thwarted by Liverpool keeper, London City move to third
summary: Against Gareth Taylor’s side, Chelsea’s lack of cutting edge was clear a week after they beat City to go top.

The calf injury picked up by Melvine Malard against City, the absence of Lauren James, who has a thigh injury, and the form of Aggie Beever-Jones, who scored her first WSL goal in more than a year in the 6-0 defeat of Charlton, have left Chelsea’s attack short.

stories.title: Ireland remind themselves that the best are beatable
summary: Ireland put a string of deflating losses against the world's best teams behind them with a hard-fought 20-17 win over South Africa in Dublin.

stories.title: AC Milan monitoring Man Utd's Fernandes - Sunday's gossip
summary: AC Milan monitoring Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes, Arsenal pair yet to start talks on new deals and Trabzonspor renew interest in Tottenham forward Richarlison, plus more.

stories.title: 'We lost two points' - Arteta on 'unacceptable' Newcastle draw
summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta says his side squandered the chance to take all three points after their 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park.
The result sees the reigning Premier League champions go six points clear at the top of the table.

stories.title: European football: Doué carried off for PSG while Kane vows to return fresh
summary: The match was stopped for five minutes to allow Doué to receive treatment to his right knee before being carried off to a backdrop of applause from the crowd at the Allianz Riviera stadium.

stories.title: Pochettino needs New Manager Bounce to break torrid Manchester United turnover | Jonathan Wilson
summary: Latest hire will depend on fresh faces and time to bed in at Old Trafford where the dugout churn is hardest to budgeEverybody knows the pattern.
A title challenge becomes clinging on for the last Champions League spot becomes mid-table.
Or a promising start becomes a troubling dip, becomes a full-on battle against relegation.Fans begin to grumble.

stories.title: Arsenal go six points clear after lively draw at Newcastle

They move up to sixth in the Premier League.

stories.title: Man City drop points to Fulham despite superb Anderson volley

stories.title: ‘Fragile’ Chelsea must toughen up after Leeds humiliation, admits Xabi Alonso
summary: Xabi Alonso is straying towards crisis territory.
Here’s a mind-bending statistic: Chelsea are eighth but have now lost more league games than Manchester United.

Leeds, superbly coached by Daniel Farke and up to sixth after two clinical strikes from Noah Okafor, Calvert-Lewin’s sixth goal of the season and a late effort from Brenden Aaronson, were so dominant that they had no real need for a helping hand from the officials.
